instruction: Open the All-Star section on nba.com.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent started on nba.com and attempted to browse women's Nike jerseys. Clicked Store link which redirected to global.nbastore.com, received HTTP 403 (Access Denied). Spent all 50 turns trying alternative store URLs and Google search, all blocked by network restrictions.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate nba.com homepage, use top navigation bar (Games, Schedule, Stats, All-Star, etc.), open/manage multiple Chrome tabs, type URLs in address bar, scroll pages
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed because external store sites (global.nbastore.com, shop.nba.com) returned 403 Access Denied due to VM network restrictions. Google search also failed with SSL certificate error.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to navigation within nba.com. The All-Star link is visible in the top navigation bar which the model successfully interacted with during the trajectory.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the NBA All-Star page. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches the all-star page pattern using regex.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (via type='rule') and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex patterns list - parameter handling is correct.
Regex pattern 'https://.*nba\.com/all-star' correctly matches the NBA All-Star page URL, covering both www.nba.com and potential subdomain variations.
Single-step instruction (navigate to All-Star section) is fully covered by the URL check - no missing verification steps.
No postconfig needed since the URL persists in the browser tab after navigation.
